meta.title: Danang. Hue. Hoi An. Let's Visit Central Vietnam!
meta.description:
Ride in a basket (literally), Make your own incense sticks (or attempt to), visit the centuries old My Son sanctuary, Cross the Golden Bridge, enter the Tu Duc Mausoleum and the Imperial Citadel. 
Come join me on my adventures in Central Vietnam.
Thanks to Travel Warehouse Inc. and Cebu Pacific.
